scripts: analysis/surrogate_and_p2_likelihood/{build,agg,ctx,feat_kg,anal_kg,cases_kg,xwalk}.py run unmodified except path edits, in outputs/work; supplementary top3_analysis.py and descriptor_rho.py (outputs/work). Data: data/raw/tri_2a_2014-2024.csv, data/processed/tri_1a/1b_2014-2024_transformed.csv.

population.definition: chemicals with >=3 TRI 2a source-reduction records with estimated reduction code R1-R3 (>=25%), reporting years 2014-2024, with valid SMILES

definitions.P2_practice_similarity: OP = cosine similarity of per-chemical vectors of counts of source-reduction activity codes (R1-R3 records), log1p(count) x IDF weight, L2-normalised, over the 88 chemicals
definitions.sector: cosine of IDF-weighted log1p 4-digit primary NAICS counts per chemical (all TRI 1a reports 2014-2024)
definitions.condition_of_use: cosine of IDF-weighted log1p Form R Section 3 chemical_activity counts (tri_1b)
definitions.context: mean of sector and condition-of-use similarity
definitions.correlation: Spearman rho over all n(n-1)/2 = 3828 chemical pairs: criterion similarity vs OP
definitions.analogue_agreement: mean OP between a chemical and its top-3 analogues under the criterion (self excluded); mean over 88 chemicals; Random uses rng(42) uniform matrix
definitions.share_better: fraction of chemicals whose context top-3 agreement > structural top-3 agreement
definitions.differed: fraction of chemicals whose top-1 structural analogue != top-1 context analogue (cases_kg.py 'different top1', argmax tie-break)
definitions.wilcoxon: paired two-sided Wilcoxon over chemicals of per-chemical top-3 agreement
definitions.descriptor_rho: Spearman between embedding cosine distance and Tanimoto distance (structural) / Jaccard activity-code distance (development-split operational anchors, 6-digit NAICS x code); src/validation EmbeddingMetrics.compute, same as docs/RESULTS.md section 4
definitions.1-BP: mean OP between 1-bromopropane and its top-3 analogues (cases_kg.json key 106-94-5, third element of each tuple)

neo4j_at_run_time.note: anal_kg.py itself reads TRI files, not Neo4j; Neo4j used only for descriptor rhos and counts. Graph counts equal the file-derived window: 194 chemicals, 1742 facilities, 2932 reports, 3041 R1-R3 records.
